title: hexboard
tagline: Dashboard for monitoring and managing assets from different chains with instant.
description:
We want to simplify how users monitor and manage their assets on various chains.

Hexboard expands the concept of monitoring and managing assets by allowing users to fully control their assets without navigating to each chain the assets belong. As a result, monitoring and managing assets has never been effortless.
how_its_made:
To allow users to monitor their assets, we're using Covalent API, where we can fetch the user's assets easily (tokens, historical portfolio, recent transactions, etc). 

To allow users to manage assets without navigating to different chains, we're using LayerZero, where users can send the transaction from one chain to call a contract on the other chain.

We're also integrate the worldcoin login to serve users a more secure and robust authentication for web3.
